### Bio:

After obtaining my bachelor's degree in Molecular Biology, I spent several years working in pharmaceutical consulting as a research scientist before deciding to pursue a graduate education in Biostatistics. I obtained my MS in Biostatistics from NYU GPH where I found my passion in survival analysis. In my spare time I enjoy rock-climbing, eating out, traveling, following Bay Area sports teams, and figuring out what TV shows/movies to watch.
